item.title: Bulletin updated at 12:20 HKT 24/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The trough of low pressure now affecting the coast of southern China will weaken gradually in the next couple of days. The upper-air disturbances will also depart. It will be brighter, but there will still be a few showers over the region. Another trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to Guangdong again later on Monday and on Tuesday. A strong easterly airstream is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the western North Pacific to the east of the Philippines will move in the general direction of the seas east of Luzon in the next couple of days.
